canonical_object.name: Sequential Pruning Operator
canonical_object.role: Internal delta_a stage that prunes candidate continuation sets before Arb_A realization arbitration.

signature.failure_condition: C_t^S = emptyset -> admissibility branch collapse or re-orientation trigger review

validated_fixture_properties.property: S can leave candidate-set cardinality unchanged.
S never increases candidate-set cardinality over registered fixtures.
Removing S changes the candidate pool without collapsing Arb_A role semantics.
S does not perform realization selection.

negative_constraints: S does not select the realized continuation.
S must not depend on post-realization outcomes.
S does not promote topology, geometry, physics-app, or empirical claims.
open_limits: Tie-break behavior inside Arb_A remains open.
Fixture validation is structural and does not prove that all engines implement the same pruning internals.
Mechanism-specific pruning implementations remain local validation targets.

textbook_sync.body_sync: Chapter 6.1 S Selection/Pruning bullet now states the registry signature, ordered pruning role, and negative constraints.
